coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Seven of nine ground-truth variable items are identifiable matches (78%): the three LLaMA-2 sizes, 2/3/4-bit weights, all four method combinations, WikiText-2 at sequence length 2048, an unquantized FP16 baseline, perplexity, and numerical-failure monitoring. Some matches are broadened beyond the required scope.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The weight-only control is incomplete: FP16/BF16 alternatives are allowed and FP16 KV caches are not explicitly fixed. Quantization is not held to per-column asymmetric quantization throughout; per-group quantization is introduced as another factor. Additional LLaMA-3, C4 evaluation, downstream tasks, and diagnostic metrics also depart from the specified experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion or results are supplied, including the low-bit benefits of QuaRot-GPTQ, persistent RTN failures, limited stabilization of RTN by QuaRot, and the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
